messages.author: 2e478b210cd3eda1
messages.subject: GGIR Part 5 - save_ms5rawlevels=TRUE
parts:
Hi all, 

We are working with GGIR and trying to get the classes from the function save_ms5rawlevels=TRUE (from either g.part5 - https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/master/man/g.part5.Rd or the main g.shell.GGIR functions) . We can get the output labeled in folder ms5.outraw with files that appear to be correct. Here is a an example of a few rows from the file: 

"date_time","class_id"
"2018-06-14T13:00:00+0100",6
"2018-06-14T13:00:05+0100",6
"2018-06-14T13:00:10+0100",6
"2018-06-14T13:00:15+0100",6
"2018-06-14T13:00:20+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:25+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:30+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:35+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:40+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:45+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:50+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:00:55+0100",13
"2018-06-14T13:01:00+0100",13

The column "class_id" appears to have the classes we are looking for but they are not labeled in any meaningful way. The numbers appear to be inherited from the function identify_levels (https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/master/man/identify_levels.Rd) but we do not know which number corresponds to which level and could not find anything in the documentation. 

Does anyone know which classes correspond to which numbers? Any help would be appreciated.

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR Part 5 - save_ms5rawlevels=TRUE
parts:
I have now implemented this in the master branch on GitHub and just uploaded a new release to CRAN. It should be available there in a couple of days.
The part5 csv output will then have an extra column with the names of the levels numbers to ease interpretation.
Thanks, Vincent
